acceptanceCriteria: A router basename is read from code or declared in configuration and applied to derived route paths.
A fixture with a basename produces joins; the test fails before the fix.
body: Residual from lane sk-1022p (PR beamfall/corvint#1548, seal 6879bb81e). Adopters that mount React Router under a basename get 0 screen joins, because the route paths AMAP derives never match navigated URLs and there is no way to declare the basename.
title: AMAP has no way to declare a router basename
